author: Daniel Greene
description:
Ready to dive into the world of scifi books but not sure where to begin? This is my attempt at an ultimate reading guide! Whether you're brand new to the genre or a returning reader looking to get back in, this video covers everything from beginner-friendly recommendations to how to navigate subgenres like cyberpuynk, space epics, and horror!
